messages:
Maya (Docs): Hi everyone — created a smaller focused PR that consolidates the Dedicated provisioning examples and adds a migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/458

Omar (Eng-Platform): Thanks Maya. Can we include a short terraform + helm example for reserving GPUs in a regional pool? Customers keep asking for a ready-to-run sample.

Maya (Docs): Yes. I want both infra and SDK examples. Also need to clarify autoscale policy behavior during region maintenance — current sentence 'may be paused' is ambiguous.

Priya (Product): Replace 'may be paused' with 'autoscaling will not create new replicas targeting nodes undergoing maintenance; existing replicas are eligible for graceful eviction per maintenance SLA.' That ties better to expectations.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Good wording. Here's a compact TF snippet I can add:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "regional_batch" {
  name     = "regional-batch"
  region   = "us-west-2"
  gpu_type = "A10G"
  gpu_count = 8
  isolation = "reserved"
}

resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "regional_batch_scale" {
  pool_id = redwood_dedicated_pool.regional_batch.id
  min_replicas = 2
  max_replicas = 16
  cooldown_seconds = 180
  metric = "gpu_utilization"
  target = 0.65
}
```

Luis (DevEx): I'll draft a Go SDK snippet and a short CLI flow for migration. Go example sketch:
```go
client := redwood.NewDedicatedClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
req := redwood.CreatePoolRequest{Name: "migrate-pool", GPUs: 2, Isolation: "reserved"}
pool, _ := client.CreatePool(req)
// attach quota and autoscale
```
CLI flow: `redwoodctl dedicated migrate --from shared --to reserved --pool migrate-pool --dry-run`

Tasha (Eng-SRE): FYI the public runbook link changed to https://runbooks.internal/redwood/dedicated-provisioning; make sure examples mention maintenance windows and regional blackout dates. Also add a short troubleshooting bullet: "If scaling stalled, check autoscale-controller logs and quota ceilings."

Maya (Docs): Added the runbook link and a troubleshooting note. CI lint failed though: MD046/code-block-style and an unresolved reference link to the SLA PDF. Anyone want to tidy?

Omar (Eng-Platform): Fixed MD046 by converting indented blocks to fenced code. Pushed at 1932104578. For the SLA link, use https://legal.redwood.com/sla/dedicated.pdf — pinged Nate for confirmation.

Nate (Legal): Confirmed SLA link is the right doc. One small ask: keep the SLA table language consistent with the contract phrasing — I'll do a quick pass before merge.

Priya (Product): Also suggest adding a one-paragraph example comparing reserved vs shared in cost/latency terms. People love small tables comparing typical VMs and expected tail latencies.

Maya (Docs): Added a mini table and example numbers (approx). Also created a short migration checklist (terraform plan, drain old pool, update routing).

ci-bot: Netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-458--docs.redwood.com — build green.

Maya (Docs): Great — thanks for the quick fixes. Leaving the final legal check to Nate then I'll merge. :raised_hands:
